g = np.array([[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in test.strip().split('\n')])
print(g.shape)
# find regions: connected components of non-8 cells
from scipy import ndimage
mask = g != 8
lab, n = ndimage.label(mask, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
print(n)
out = g.copy()
for i in range(1, n+1):
    cells = np.argwhere(lab == i)
    rs, cs = cells[:,0], cells[:,1]
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = rs.min(), rs.max(), cs.min(), cs.max()
    region = g[r0:r1+1, c0:c1+1]
    colors = set(np.unique(region)) - {0}
    color = colors.pop() if len(colors)==1 else None
    if color is None: continue
    scells = np.argwhere(region == color)
    sr0,sr1 = scells[:,0].min(), scells[:,0].max()
    sc0,sc1 = scells[:,1].min(), scells[:,1].max()
    pat = region[sr0:sr1+1, sc0:sc1+1]
    ph, pw = pat.shape
    for r in range(r0, r1+1):
        for c in range(c0, c1+1):
            out[r,c] = pat[(r-sr0-r0)%ph, (c-sc0-c0)%pw] if True else out[r,c]
            # anchor to bbox top-left within region
    # note: use (r-r0-sr0) etc
print(out.tolist())
